7.	Use the Flask framework to handle the web server functionality.
8.	Utilize the ffmpeg library to convert images to video streams and stream videos directly to the browser.
9.	Incorporate the pygame library to play the metronome sound in the background.
10.	Ensure the application is secure and handles file access properly.
11.	Implement a user interface using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that allows users to interact with the application and control the playback and metronome settings.
12.	The web application should support the streaming of various file formats, including JPG, PNG, MP4, AVI, and M4A.
13.	Optimize the performance of the application to ensure smooth streaming and responsiveness.
14.	Test the application on different devices and browsers to ensure compatibility and functionality.
